candidates.explanation: updateByHash ignores conditions.hash. The UPDATE filters only by session id, so any refresh token for that session passes, even one carrying a stale (rotated) hash. The hash is never compared with the stored value, so replaying the old refresh token succeeds and issues a new token pair. The document (Mongo) repository does filter on hash, which confirms the relational version is wrong.

fix.description: Include the hash in the update's where clause so a stale hash matches no rows and returns null, which makes refreshToken throw Unauthorized.
